listing.title: Lovebirds Couple Mug, Watercolor Love Birds and Roses All Over Print Coffee Mug, Matching Mugs for Couples, Anniversary Gift
listing.description: Pairs of watercolor lovebirds in grass green, aqua and gold, with rosy peach faces, sit side by side on blossoming branches with a little painted heart between them. Garden roses in pink and deep rose with their leaves, little lavender, pink and golden flowers, red berries, small hearts and gold sparkles fill the spaces all the way around the mug on a warm cream background. Made for matching mugs, one for each of you, with no names or dates, so it suits an anniversary, a wedding, a new home or just because.

listing.trademark_check: Legal Desk screen 2026-11-12: web searches '"LOVEBIRDS" trademark mugs class 21 registered' and 'LOVEBIRDS trademark 97191860 OR 85870893 OR 77789203' found US LOVEBIRDS marks only for cosmetics (Class 3), all dead (Coty 77789203 abandoned 2012, Coty reg. 4446806 cancelled 2020, Daniela Gozlan 97191860 dead); a 1994 LOVE BIRDS Class 21 application was abandoned. A Lithuanian national LOVE BIRDS registration (2024 0932, MB Stankeviciu projektai) covers Class 21 drinking vessels and Class 25, in Lithuania only. The art has no lettering; 'lovebirds' and 'love birds' describe the birds pictured. tmsearch.uspto.gov is blocked from our sessions; this is a search-engine screen, not a clearance.
